topic.angle: Measuring distance in a social network

card.title: How many friends apart are we?

body.question: An old idea says anyone is connected to anyone else through six other people. When Facebook measured its friend graph in 2016, how many people on average stood between two users?
body.reveal: About three and a half. Across the 1.59 billion people active on Facebook, the average distance was 4.57 steps, which is 3.57 intermediaries. Friend networks are smaller than they feel.

probes.question: What is the folk idea that everyone is connected through a certain number of other people?

sources.title: Three and a half degrees of separation (Facebook Research)
